import sqlite3
conn = sqlite3.connect('/workspace/world/world.sqlite')
conn.row_factory = sqlite3.Row

def show(sql, params=()):
    print('SQL:', sql, params)
    for r in conn.execute(sql, params):
        print(dict(r))
    print()

print('=== TABLES ===')
for r in conn.execute("SELECT name FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table' ORDER BY name"):
    print(r[0])

print('\n=== lab_result ===')
show('SELECT * FROM lab_result')
